list.title: WaibuDb#exportData
list.description:
Export data and save it as a file you can download later. This method is intended to be called by a worker process.

If sumba is loaded, file download is handled by sumba download management which provides you a slick UI to monitor the download progress and status.

If not, file is saved in standard bajo download directory.

list.title: module:CRUDHandler
list.description:
Function handlers for CRUD operations.

To use these handlers, you need to import them first and call them with the appropriate parameters.

list.title: module:CRUDHandler.THandlerMap
list.description: Map of CRUD action names to their corresponding handler functions.

list.title: module:CRUDHandler.addHandler
list.description:
Handler for rendering the add view of a model.

To use this handler, you must import it first and call it with the necessary parameters. For example:

const { importModule } = this.app.bajo
const addHandler = await importModule('waibuDb:/lib/crud/add-handler.js')
const result = await addHandler.call(this, { model: 'YourModelName', req, reply })

list.title: module:CRUDHandler.allHandler
list.description:
Handler for routing to the appropriate CRUD action based on the provided options.

To use this handler, you must import it first and call it with the necessary parameters. For example:

const { importModule } = this.app.bajo
const allHandler = await importModule('waibuDb:/lib/crud/all-handler.js')
const result = await allHandler.call(this, { model: 'YourModelName', action: 'list', req, reply })

For more information on the available actions, see {@link module:CRUDHandler.THandlerMap THandlerMap}.

list.title: module:CRUDHandler.deleteHandler
list.description:

list.title: module:CRUDHandler/Helper.addOnsHandler
list.description:
Add-ons handler for generating chart options based on the schema's aggregate settings.

This function retrieves the aggregate settings from the schema and generates chart options for each setting. The generated chart options are encoded in base64 and returned as an array of add-ons.
